scope: development-only folds-3/4 selection of an exact protected residual ensemble combining the fixed DOFA scene probe with a conservative Gaussian-synthetic ViT scene head

fixed_dofa.source: passed train-fitted DOFA folds-3/4 selection; no refit or search

fixed_dense.source: expanded-UNEP anchored dense residual already positive on folds 3/4 and independently positive on protected fold 2
fixed_dense.role: mask path only; scene ensemble selection cannot change it

architecture.gaussian_component: bounded-reproducibility replicate of the scene-aligned physics-contrast Vision Transformer trained on analytical wind-aligned Gaussian plume/unchanged-background pairs plus authorized real fit folds; each strength must pass the separately frozen replicate gates
architecture.dofa_component: fixed five-projection DOFA change/extreme-feature logistic residual with fit-fold-only global normalization
architecture.formula: inside local-logit coordinates above 0.25, add the conservative Gaussian-ViT residual and the fixed DOFA residual to current; below 0.25 preserve current exactly
architecture.dense_formula: released MARS pixel logit plus fixed 0.10 independently trained anchored endpoint correction

search.selection_rule: all gates, then worst-fold AP, paired-site AP lower bound, worst-sensor AP, pooled AP, and smaller Gaussian strength
search.source: only conservative strengths with exact pooled recall preservation in the already completed Gaussian experiment

gates.pass_action: freeze a genuinely external or new-cohort confirmation; do not reopen fold 2 or the official test

invariants: This exact two-candidate grid, evaluator, components, protection gate, bootstrap, and gates are recommitted after the exact-replay rejection and before the bounded-replicate raw Gaussian scene cache exists.
After cache generation, only the two pending cache/result hashes and protocol status may change before evaluation.
The evaluator opens only the shared folds-2/3/4 feature file long enough to select folds 3/4; it does not open separate fold-0 or fold-1 feature files.
Fold 2 labels/outcomes and the official test are not accessed for scene selection.
The fixed dense path is supported only by compact prior receipts and cannot influence scene candidate ranking.
Bulk logits and feature caches remain Git-ignored; only compact reproducibility artifacts are committed.
A pass authorizes a separately frozen independent confirmation and is not itself a claim about the official test.
